name: sc-referee
description: Conservative workflow auditing and bounded pre-analysis method contracts

interface.shortDescription: Conservative audits and bounded method contracts
interface.longDescription: Uses the installed sc-referee CLI to audit scientific workflows without executing project-authored code and, before coding, to freeze either the supported expected-count/background profile or one atomic registered requirement supplied by a scientist. It separates demonstrated Findings from unknowns and coverage limits.
defaultPrompt: Freeze one scientist-supplied closed analysis requirement before coding.
Replay this sc-referee audit from its semantic lock.
